attachments.insertion_landmark: transverse process of the vertebra directly above

innervation.root_levels: segmental dorsal rami (the anterior cervical set takes ventral rami)

actions: laterally flex the vertebral column segmentally

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Unusual in being supplied by BOTH dorsal and ventral rami depending on the set -- the posterior by dorsal rami, the anterior cervical by ventral rami.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
